arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back, about 32-34 min. Goal: even effort near sustainable shaft power (about 160-166 W pod, boat CP 101 W) after the hard start; keep pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) above about 0.3 until 1500 m to go, then spend it down to empty by the line; finish sprint at about 400-500 m to go. Watch for incidents: speed drop at same pod power (weed on rudder -> clear_rudder), pod reading drifting vs boat-model power, wind or current changes between legs, radio course changes (set_race_distance and tell). Compare legs in same direction with legs().
Good start. Settle now into your long race rhythm.
